tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor

sgrub tshul dogs gcod dang bcas pa'i 'khrul sel zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ rgyal ba'i yab gcig brtan pa'i 'khor lo nyid/ /'jigs mdzad khro rgyal dbang po'i bskur bstan pa/ /gang der gus pas btud nas de nyid kyi/ /mdun bskyed ngag don bya tshul zur bkol bri/ /de yang 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma 'di la ngag 'don mdzad mkhan mang du mchis shing*/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la mchod ring lta bu'i dus su rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i phyag len dar yang*/ gzhan stong rtsa lta bu'i dus su rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i phyag len ma dar 'dug pas/ 'dir de lta bu la bsams nas 'chad pa la gsum/ dkyil 'khor sgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ ji ltar sgrub tshul/ 'phros bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag 'jug len pa dang*/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba dang*/ stong rtsa lta bu tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi tshe bdag bskyed rkyang pa tsam gyis mi mchog gi /mdun bskyed rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung zhig dmigs rten byas nas sgrub dgos te/ bdag bskyed rkyang ba bsgoms pas ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i go mi chod pa'i phyir te/ rgyud dang mkhas grub kyis bdag bskyed las logs su mdun bskyed sgrub tshul gsungs pa la dgos pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ji ltar sgrub tshul la gnyis/ thun mong du spyir bstan pa dang*/ 'jigs byed la bdag mdun tha mi dad du bya tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ spyir dkyil 'khor sgrub tshul la bdag mdun tha dad du byed pa dang*/ tha mi dad du byed pa'i tshul gnyis las/ rgyud sde'i 'og ma gsum gyi skabs su bdag mdun tha dad du byas nas bsgrub dgos te/ de gsum gyi skabs bdag mdun tha mi dad du byas nas sgrub tshul tshad ldan gyi gzhung las mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ bla med kyi skabs su bdag mdun tha dad dang tha mi dad du byas nas sgrub pa'i tshul gnyis yod cing*/

de la yang bod dang 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul yod de/ sngon byon bod kyi mkhas pa kha cig dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i dus su dang po bdag bskyed bsgoms te/ de nas mdun bskyed bsgrubs zin pa na bdag bskyed kyi rten brten pa rnams dang gcig tu bsres pa bdag mdun tha mi dad du byed par 'dod ces mkhas grub rjes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa'i lugs la bdag mdun tha mi dad du byed tshul la gnyis yod de/ dang po ni/ bdag bskyed zur du mi bsgom par mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i gzhi rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang nyid phyin par mos nas/ chos 'byung 'byung bzhi dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ lha bskyed pa na cho ga gsum pa bskyed tsam zhig gi sgo nas mdzad de/ tshul 'di ni gshin rje gshed dmar nag lta bu la rung gi 'dus pa dang 'jigs byed lta bu la mi rung ste skye shi bar do gsum dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam sgom pa med pa'i phyir zhes mkhas grub rje bzhed/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum la yang bdag mdun tha dad dang tha mi dad du byed pa'i tshul gnyis yod kyang*/ klu byang rjes 'brang dang bcas pas 'dus pa la bdag mdun tha mi dad byed nas sgrub/ grub chen dā ri ka pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pas bde mchog la bdag mdun tha dad du mdzad/ grub chen dpal 'dzin rjes 'brang dang bcas pas gshin rje gshed la bdag mdun tha mi dad byas nas sgrub/ sngon dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng ba'i lugs 'dzin pa phal cher yang bdag mdun tha mi dad mdzad cing*/ rgya gar ba'i lugs gzhan la yang de ltar mdzad pa mang bar snang la/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i lugs la ni bdag mdun gnyis gcig tu byas nas sgrub pa'i tshul mang ngo*/ /rang lugs kyi bdag mdun tha dad dang tha mi dad kyi don gang zhe na/ mkhas grub kyi rgyud sde spyi rnam las/ tha dad kyi phyed lugs ni/

sngon du bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa la 'jug pa na rang nyid mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bris pa'i dbus su phyin pa'i dmigs pa yang mi byed/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal yang mi byed par mdun bskyed sgrub par byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ tha mi dad kyi don yang de nyid las/ bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi don ni/ mdud bskyed kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid gzhal yas khang dngos dang*/ rang nyid de'i dbus kyi gtso bor dngos kyi nga rgyal 'jog pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i dus su rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs par yang mos dgos so/ /'o na bdag mdun tha dad mi dad dang 'jug pa tha dad mi dad kyi don ji ltar yin zhe na/ de ni cang gya zhabs kyi 'khrul spong las/ sngon du bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms te de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa na rang nyid bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin pa'i mos pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa gang yang mi byed par mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni bdag mdun tha dad dang 'jug pa tha dad/ 'dus pa'i dkyil chog dbang don de nyid rab gsal nas bshad pa ltar/ sngon du bdag bskyed bsgoms te nyer bsdu byas nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa na rang nyid bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug par mos shing mdun bskyed kyi lha'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas sgrub pa ni/ bdag mdun tha mi dad dang 'jug pa tha dad/ bcu gsum ma gsum gyi dkyil chog rin chen 'phreng ba nas bshad pa ltar/ sngon du bdag bskyed mi sgom par mdun bskyed sgrub pa na rang nyid bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug par mos te bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dbyer med du cho ga gcig gis sgrub pa ni bdag bdun tha mi dad dang 'jug pa tha mi dad yin no/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mdoran bdag bskyed bsgoms zin rjes mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i tshe rang nyid bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'jug pa'i mos pa yang mi byed/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i nga rgyal yang mi byed par mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni bdag mdun gnyis snga phyir bsgrubs pas 'jug pa tha dad/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa na bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin pa'i mos pa dang gtso bo'i nga rgyal mi byed pas bdag mdun yang tha dad yin la/ bdag bskyed sngon du btang yang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa ni bdag mdun gnyis so sor byas pas 'jug pa tha dad kyang*/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sgo nas bsgrubs pas bdag mdun tha mi dad/ bdag bskyed logs su mi sgom par dang po nyid nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa na rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs par mos nas bdag mdun gnyis 'jug pa gcig gis sgrub pa ni bdag bskyed logs su med par bdag mdun cig car du bsgrubs pas 'jug pa gcig cing*/ tshul des na bdag mdun gnyis kyang tha mi dad yin no/ /de'i phyir bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig pa'i tha mi dad yin na/ bdag mdun tha mi dad yin pas kyang khyab bo/ /rgyud sde bzhi ka'i skabs su bdag mdun tha dad du sgrub pa'i tshe/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa na dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la sogs pa'i lha'i nga rgyal mi 'dzin cing*/ spyir mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal mi rung pa min te/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba lta bu'i dus su rang nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal la gnas dgos pa yang mang du 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /bdag mdun tha dad mi dad kyi rnam dbye ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i tshul la 'byung gi bdag bskyed kyi mngon rtogs rgyas pa sgom pa la bdag mdun tha dad mi dad kyi rnam dbye med par rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos bshad pa'i rjes su 'brang nas cang gya zhabs kyis kyang bshad de legs pa yin no/

/'o na/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang*/ paṇa chen gong ma sogs kyis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim gyi khrid yig 'ga' zhig las/ dbye ba med pa'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma 'di bdag mdun tha mi dad yin zhes bshad pa de ji ltar yin zhe na/ phyi ma de dag ni phal cher rtag brtan gyi par ma des de lta bu'i rkyen byas par snang zhing*/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang paṇa chen gyi gsung de dkyil 'khor sgrub dus lta bu la dgongs pa'am sngon gyi bla chen 'ga' zhig gi 'khrid rgyun ltar bkod pa yin gyi/ rang lugs dngos min te/ paṇa chen rin po ches tshul de la dgag pa mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma la bdag mdun tha mi dad 'jug pa gcig tu sgrub tshul ni/ bdag bskyed logs su bya mi dgos pa'i tshul ni bshad zin cing*/ 'dir sngags sku tsam gyis mi chog gi dkyil 'khor dgos pa de yang rdul tshon dka' bas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor zhig lta gon bya zhing*/ byung na stegs kyi khar leb mor bkram nas mtha' mchod pas bskor bar bya'o/ /'dir tshad med bzhi yan chad sngon du btang nas der bum pa sgrub pa ni rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i bzhed pa yin par cang gya zhabs 'chad cing*/ paṇa chen rin po ches 'jigs byed kyi dkyil chog las ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dang tshogs zhing gnyis kyi bar du bum pa sgrub par bshad de/ gang byas kyang chog mod/ sngon ma nyid bde bar mngon no/ /rab gnas lta bu la ni bdag bskyed rkyang pa'i mjug tu byas na bde zhing*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa tsam la ni bum pa dgos pa'i nges pa med pas/ tshad med zhi bsgoms pa'i mjug tu rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug par mos nas sngags kyis bsangs te/ sngags gnyis kyi don bsgom pa nas/ mi'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhir gyur zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin yin zhing*/ de nas oṃ hrī:ṣti:nas/

thim par gyur gyi bar gzhan rnams kyang gzhung bzhin la/ shar gyi gdan la 'khod ces pa'i dod la shar gyi mtshan ma dang ngo bo dbyer med du gyur zhes bya zhing*/ des lha gzhan rnams la'ang rigs bsgres nas 'don tshul bsgyur ro/ /bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig pa la skabs 'dir phyogs skyong dgug bskyed byas kyang rung bar 'ga' zhig nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ 'on kyang rje'i dkyil 'khor chog dang*/ 'du 'dzin/ ba so ba/ lha btsun sogs kyi lhan thabs su de ltar mi 'byung zhes bshad pas de mi bya bar/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig gnyis su kṣeṃ/ zhes pa nas/ rang nyid la thim par gyur pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya la/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe 'jam dpal rang bzhin ma sbyor zhing*/ gong du phyogs skyong dgug bskyed byas na rgyas 'debs kyang bya'o/ /rang nyid gtso bo las mar me gcig la gnyis chad kyi tshul du phye nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad kyi phyi rol tu gnas par bsam/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ sogs kyi chu bzhi dang*/ rgyal ba rnams kyi yon tan mchog gi sku/ zhes sogs kyis nyer spyod rol mo/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs sam/ rin chen dbang gi sogs kyis 'dod yon/ 'dzam bu gling dang zhes sogs kyis rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ lha so so'i sngags kyis nang mchod 'bul zhing*/ gnyis med thun mong mas bstod nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /stong rtsa lta bu la grangs mang dgos pa'i dbang gis chu bzhi sogs la tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa'am/ sngags tsam la sogs pas mchod pas dbye bsdu shes par byas nas skabs dang bstun no/ /gtor ma 'bum tshul la lugs gnyis te/ rje'i dkyil chog rin chen 'phreng ba nas mngon rtogs kyi skabs su bshad pa'i gtor ma 'bul tshul la kha 'phangs pa ltar na/ bdag mdun tha mi dad yin yang gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshe gtor mgron sogs su bskyed nas 'bul dgos par mngon la/

paṇa chen rin po sogs 'ga' zhig sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid la 'bul bar mdzad de/ rang lugs ni bzhed pa ltar bya dgos na'ang*/ stong rtsa lta bu'i dus su logs su byed pa ma lcogs na ni sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'bul rung bar gsal te gsang 'dus bzhin no/ / de la'ang phyogs skyong gong du bskyed pa dang*/ gtor mgron logs su byed na skabs 'dir bskyed pa'i tshul gnyis yod pas dbye ba shes dgos/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i bskyed chog 'bring po ni da lta/ phyag len du byed pa ltar bdag gis kyang gzhan du brjod zin la/ rgyas pa ni gzhan 'bring po ltar la/ re mig dgu pa'i dbus dang*/ nang gi phyogs gzhan gsum dang sgo bzhir sna tshogs pad ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ nang gi shar dang*/ grwa bzhi dang*/ zhes pa nas/ zur re re/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag /ces pa nas/ g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ nang gi shar du gti mug gshin rje gshes dkar po/ /zhes pa nas/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyi'i grwa bzhir mi'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi/ zhes pa'i bar gyis lha rnams gsal gdab cing*/ oṃ hrī:ṣtiḥzhes sogs kyis phyogs skyong dgug bskyed rgyas pa gzhung ltar bya/ lha rnams kyi skye mched mig gnyis su kṣiṃ kṣiṃ sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ don grub kyis dbu rgyan cing*/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa nas/ rgyas btab par gyur pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ hrī:ṣtiḥha sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ nang mchod phul nas/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin zhes sogs kyis bstod/ mchod bstod rgyas pa byas na'ang legs/ de nas 'das ma 'das gnyis kyi gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te gzhung bzhin 'bul/ chos rgyal gyi gtor 'bul yang rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas nas 'phrin las bcol te gshegs gsol bya ba sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ro/

/bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig pa la brtan bzhugs dgos so/ /gsum pa 'phros ni/ da lta tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la dmigs nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma 'di la stong tsam mdzad pa mang 'dug kyang*/ phal cher bdag bskyed rkyang ba dang sbyar ba'i stong rtsa'i grangs mdzad de/ tshul de ltar byas pa la phan yon med pa ma yin na'ang phyag len rnam dag tu mi 'thad de/ de la ni tshogs gsog pa dang sgrib pa sbyong ba'i dgos pa che khyad dkyil 'khor zhig sgrub cing mchod dgos la/ bdag bskyed rkyang ba sgom pa ni bsnyen pa dang rab gnas sbyin sregs sogs dang dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pa lta bu'i ched yin bas mdun bskyed sgrub pa ltar tshogs gsog pa'i nus pa mi che ba'i phyir ro/ /des na tshe 'das nam gang gi ched yin kyang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs shing mchod par bya'i/ bdag bskyed gcig pu tsam gyis mi chog go /'on kyang 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i tshe 'jug pa gcig tu byed tshul ni bshad zin pa ltar te/ da lta phal cher 'jigs byed stong rtsa la bdag bskyed rkyang ba mdzad pa 'di sla chos su song ba yin no/ /de'i phyir sbyin bdag la phan che ba zhig mdzad 'dod na/ 'jigs byed stong rtsa lta bu la ni bdag bskyed tsam ma yin par bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig pa'i tshul rje yab sras rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar bya bar rigs so/ /gzhan yang 'jigs byed sogs kyi sgo nas lho sgo mdzad pa'i tshe bum bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung med par bum par chu gtsang tsam blugs nas byed pa 'di yang mi 'thad de/ de la 'og tu khrus gsol ba zhig yod kyang de tsam gy-is bsgrub bya'i nad gdon dang sdig sgrib gang spyong dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang sla chos su song ba yin no/ /des na bum sgrub byed dgos shing de yang rang rang gi cho ga'i bum bskyed rgyas pa dang*/ /de ma lcogs na bsdus pa byed dgos la/

de yang ma lcogs na ma tha gzungs bzlas pa'i khrus bum tsam zhig nges par bsgrub par bya dgos te/ gzhan du na tshe 'das lta bu bslus par mi 'gyur ram/ de'i tshe bsang chu tsam sgrub pas kyang mi chog ste/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i gzungs gzhan ni dkyil 'khor ba'i lha'i sngags gzhan rnams bzlas na legs pa'i phyir ro/ /bum pa'i bskyed chog bsdus pa la kun rig lta bu la lha lnga dang*/ 'jigs byed la yang gshin rje gshed rigs lnga bskyed dgos la/ 'dir bcu gsum ma la de nyid kyi lha'i bskyed chog bsdus pa'i tshul 'di ltar byas na'ang chog ste/ de yang bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ byung bas bum pa dkar po/ /lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ tapte taptai/ nas/ dbyer mi byed par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la nang lha'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i ri'u mig dgu pa'i dbus su/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed yam yum mam zhal dgu /nas/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed yab yum/ zhes pa nas/ shar lho'i tsa rtsi ka yab yum nas/ mtshams bzhir mi'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhir gyur/ lha rnams kyi mig gnyis su kṣeṃḥrna bar dzriṃḥnas hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de nas oṃ hrīḥha zhes sogs gzhung ltar ram/ bsdu na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥha sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa so so dang dbyer med du gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur bas rigs bdag so so'i dbu brgyan par gyur/

de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ya manta ka sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūṃ swāhā nas/ shapta'i bar ram/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥha sogs kyis mchod/ nang mchod phul nas gnyis med mas bstod la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas sku'i cha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam la rtsa sngags sogs sngags rnams ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ci 'grub bzlas nas yig brgya brjod cing*/ 'dir ye shes pa ma gshegs chog pas/ bum pa'i lha rnams chags pa chen po'i mes zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ zhes byas na legs so/ /mkhas pa'i dgongs pa mkhas pa'i lugs ji bzhin/ legs par rtogs nas legs par 'chad dka' yang*/ /phyogs tsam shes ltar phyogs tsam brjod pa 'di/ /blo ldan dag gi blo la 'bab gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni/ sngar don gnyer can gzhan gyis bskul zhing*/ phyis mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang du mkhyen cing dad dang rnam dpyod zung du 'brel ba'i yar bo'i rab 'byams pa brtson 'grus bzang pos ri khrod nas rang bzhin la phan 'dod lhag bsam gyis bskul ba'i ngo bor/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste/ par gyi yi ge pa ni snyan ngag yig sdeb sogs la blo byang ba'i dka' bcu blo bzang dbang phyug go /madgalaṃ//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrub tshul dogs gcod 'khrul sel bzhugs/ -PAGE 402--PAGE 403--PAGE 392-
